domain: All 254 nonconstant events over three independent binary categorical variables, for each of 25 deterministic posterior settings
assumptions: Every conjunction joins conditionally independent subformulas
Every disjunction joins conditionally independent or mutually exclusive subformulas
All tested posterior probabilities are strictly between zero and one
Posterior maps are differentiable softmax functions
